faq.headline: Frequently asked questions.
faq.supporting: What people usually ask before we start.

items.question: What does the process actually look like?
items.answer: We start by understanding how your business operates, not by writing code. From there we analyze, design, develop, implement, and improve the system together with you.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: It depends on scope. After the initial consultation you get a clear timeline before we start, not a generic estimate.

items.question: How does pricing work?
items.answer: Every project is quoted based on what you actually need. The initial consultation to understand your process is free.

items.question: How secure is my information?
items.answer: Every system we build uses role-based access control and encrypts data, both in transit and at rest.

items.question: Does this replace the tools I already use?
items.answer: Not necessarily. We design around what you already use when it makes sense, and connect your tools to each other instead of ripping them out.
